item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Files cross-region data copy and synchronization with Azure Storage Mover
item.description:
Azure Files now supports copying and synchronizing file share data across storage accounts, Azure regions, and subscriptions within the same tenant using Azure Storage Mover. The feature is in public preview and supports scheduled incremental transfers to maintain secondary copies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB)
item.description:
Azure Storage Mover now supports agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB) in public preview. The migration can move data from Windows Server or NAS shares without deploying, registering, or maintaining a migration agent.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate from AWS FSx for Windows File Server to Azure Files with Azure Storage Mover
item.description:
Azure Storage Mover now supports preview agentless, cloud-to-cloud migration from AWS FSx for Windows File Server (SMB) to Azure Files (SMB). This lets users move Windows file shares from FSx to Azure Files without deploying or managing a migration agent.

  • Source: Azure Updates
